# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest released version of `dev-tools` receives security fixes.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| Latest  | :white_check_mark:  |
| Older   | :x:                 |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability, please **do not open a public GitHub
issue**. Instead, report it privately using one of the following methods:

- Open a [GitHub Security Advisory](../../security/advisories/new) for this repository, or
- Contact the maintainer directly via the profile listed on the
  [repository owner's GitHub page](https://github.com/brandadrian).

Please include as much detail as possible:

- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact.
- Steps to reproduce the issue.
- Any relevant logs, screenshots, or proof-of-concept code.

## Response

We aim to acknowledge reports within a few business days and will keep you
updated as the issue is investigated and resolved. Once a fix is available, a
new release will be published and the reporter credited (unless anonymity is
requested).
